$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：太陰獨坐卯酉，《深造講義》p.100。

rules.text: 你的太陰化祿，意志容易在感情上薄弱。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin is transformed by Lu, so your will tends to weaken where feelings are involved.

source.quote: 化禄者易对感情意志薄弱

rules.text: 你的太陰化忌，意志容易在物質上薄弱。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin is transformed by Ji, so your will tends to weaken where material things are involved.

source.quote: 化忌者对物质意志薄弱

rules.text: 你的太陰化權，意志力因此增強，比較撐得住。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin is transformed by Quan, which strengthens your will and helps you hold out.

rules.text: 你的太陰化科，意志力因此增強，比較撐得住。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin is transformed by Ke, which strengthens your will and helps you hold out.

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的天同化忌，令你的意志容易薄弱，耽於享樂或物欲。
rules.en: Tian Tong opposite you is transformed by Ji, so your will can weaken, drifting into pleasure or material wants.

rules.text: 天機所在的那一步運，對你非常重要：天機化科往往是一生事業奠基之時；天機化忌，就要不理是非，我行我素。
rules.en: The phase through Tian Ji matters greatly to you: with Tian Ji in Merit it often lays the foundation of your career; with Tian Ji in Hindrance, ignore the gossip and go your own way.

source.quote: 对原局太阴守命的人来说非常重要

rules.text: 意志堅強的你，行到武曲所在的運，是積極有利的運程。
rules.en: With a firm will, the phase through Wu Qu is an active and favourable one for you.

source.quote: 对意志坚强的太阴有利

rules.text: 意志較軟的你，行到七殺、破軍、貪狼的運，以守成為佳，也不宜陷入感情困擾。
rules.en: With a softer will, in the phases through Qi Sha, Po Jun and Tan Lang, hold what you have, and keep clear of emotional entanglements.

source.quote: 以守成为佳，亦不宜陷于感情困扰
